featured_reviews.name: Vinay Kurmi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst dry-cleaning service for a puffer jacket.

The first time, they delivered my puffer jacket packed while still wet, which led to mould/moss developing by the time I received it. After I complained, they rewashed the jacket, but now it smells strongly of cheap soap/detergent.

Not only did they fail to clean it properly the first time, but even after rewashing, the jacket is still in
terrible condition. The down filling has been completely ruined there’s no fluff left at all. A puffer jacket is essentially unusable if the down is damaged, and their poor handling has destroyed it.
I would never recommend Tumbledry to anyone. Extremely disappointing service and careless treatment of expensive clothing.

Absolutely pathetic and will never use them again or recommend to anyone
